topic: Stable Live Build After Tile Visuals And Chill Philosopher
userLatestRead: User said the build is pretty good and stable after testing. Requested a big handoff.
currentGoal: Preserve the current stable, live, pushed, Mac-synced state after fixing tile visual bugs, cactus AoE behavior, adding Chill Philosopher, enlarging class portraits, and centering the initial 1x1 grass patch.

shippedCommits.message: Fix tile visuals and cactus hazard effects
summary: Fixed grass tile visual artifacts that appeared when fields expanded or the play screen size changed.
Gave cactus tiles a more distinct reddish/dark hazard background so they are easier to spot.
Prevented crits and other AoE-style touches from activating cactus tiles or applying cactus prick effects.
Added the Chill Philosopher class with the Air-Conditioned Detachment passive.
Generated and processed the approved light-brown-haired class portrait at public/assets/ui/classes/chill-philosopher.png.
Added Chill Philosopher upgrades Climate Control and Smug Syllogism.
Added class quests and reward/skill-branch classification for the new upgrades.
Increased class portrait badge sizes on the class overview screen.
Fixed initial 1x1 field alignment by calculating board visual size as tile area plus gaps between tiles, excluding a trailing gap after the final row/column.

importantImplementationNotes: The first-patch centering fix lives in src/game/scenes/GameScene.ts. getBoardVisualSize(tileCount) now returns tileCount * TILE_SIZE + max(0, tileCount - 1) * TILE_GAP. This keeps one-tile fields centered in their frame and avoids the prior half-gap drift.
Do not reintroduce board size math as bounds.width * (TILE_SIZE + TILE_GAP) unless deliberately changing the visual model; that formula includes a phantom trailing gap.
Cactus tiles use dedicated base textures tile-cactus-dirt and tile-cactus-stubble. The AoE guard should keep cactus tiles from being touched by indirect effects.
Chill Philosopher is now a valid CharacterClassId. Removing it later would need save-selection migration handling.
The approved class portrait is the light-brown-haired revision. The first darker-haired generation should not replace it.
Class portrait sizing was intentionally bumped in TitleScene because the overview had room and the previous portraits read too small.

knownIssuesAndRisks: Chill Philosopher balance is intentionally conservative and has only had short subjective playtesting. If it feels too mild, tune Air-Conditioned Detachment or the Climate Control/Smug Syllogism values.
The new Chill Philosopher skill nodes fit the current tree, but future class additions may need a broader skill tree layout pass.

The first-patch centering fix touches shared board geometry. It was visually checked on a fresh 1x1 run and build-tested, but future layout work should watch small fields, expanded large fields, panning, zooming, and mobile portrait.

The official npm run sync:mac:handoff script refuses to run while tracked local files are dirty. Because AGENTS.md and docs/DESKTOP_MAC_SYNC_WORKFLOW.md remain dirty and unrelated, the Mac was synced with a direct clean fast-forward instead.
nextRecommendedSteps: Keep this stable build as the baseline. If the user asks for more feature work, start by reading this handoff, then run git status --short.
If more gameplay tuning is requested, start with Chill Philosopher pacing: regrow time, combo window, rare touch bonus, Climate Control values, and Smug Syllogism values.
If more visual polish is requested, add targeted browser checks for the exact viewport or field size involved before changing shared board math.
If performance-sensitive field layout changes happen, use npm run build and consider the perf harness at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?perfHarness&tiles=1200.
At some calm moment, ask the user whether to keep, commit, or discard the unrelated local docs/AGENTS changes. Do not decide that silently.
doNotRevert: Do not revert e3dd07c or 8efb893 unless explicitly asked; both are live and user-approved as stable.
Do not undo the board visual-size helper or bring back trailing-gap board dimensions.
Do not replace public/assets/ui/classes/chill-philosopher.png with the earlier dark-haired generated image.
Do not remove chill_philosopher from character class validation without save compatibility handling.

Do not stage, clean, or revert unrelated AGENTS.md, docs/DESKTOP_MAC_SYNC_WORKFLOW.md, Dutch automation docs, GAME_SYSTEMS_REFERENCE CLAUDE.md, title-art artifacts, MIDI/AIF files, or old test handoff unless explicitly instructed.
